inputs.text: {"high_level_description": "A cracked rose gold teleport hoop lies tilted and half sunk in a scorched landing ring, plum starry light spilling from the crack, a small sun burst free of its cage and held in the air by three rose gold shards, a ribbon of glowing star map rising out, lighting the floor warm.", "style_description": {"aesthetics": "the glowing heart of a bare camp on a high plateau above the clouds, the warm centre the camp gathers around, one coherent pixel art scene", "lighting": "cold morning sun from the upper left with cool blue shadows, and warm golden light from the small sun pooling on the stone floor round the hoop", "medium": "pixel art", "art_style": "crisp clustered pixel art at one pixel size, flat colour planes with hard pixel edges, a few hue shifted shades per material, the same pixel art as the floor around it", "color_palette": ["#261B30", "#34242D", "#452A34", "#443230", "#4B3832", "#4E3533", "#534144", "#7D5D57", "#C29B7B", "#C0A88B", "#CDAE7E", "#D2AB7D", "#CDB084", "#D4B586", "#D2BD92", "#DAC59D"]}, "compositional_deconstruction": {"background": "the flat tan stone floor of a bare high plateau, a dark scorched landing ring in the middle of it, in bright cold morning light", "elements": [{"type": "obj", "bbox": [400, 384, 700, 565], "desc": "a cracked rose gold teleport hoop lying tilted and half sunk in the scorched ground, plum starry light spilling out of the crack", "color_palette": ["#C59A7A", "#CCAF83", "#F9C06F", "#352945", "#58384E"]}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [160, 496, 380, 634], "desc": "a small bright sun burst free of its cage, held in the air by three floating rose gold shards", "color_palette": ["#FFF6DC", "#FFE29A", "#FFB85C", "#CCAF83", "#F9C06F"]}, {"type": "obj", "bbox": [90, 359, 500, 590], "desc": "a ribbon of glowing star map with tiny planets rising out of the cracked hoop", "color_palette": ["#B2BACD", "#B9C6D7", "#CCE2E8", "#8E4271", "#FFB85C"]}]}}
